spots.name: Königsberg

hours.note: Typical hours — check the official site

spots.summary: Königsberg was a German city established in the 13th century, which after the defeat of Nazi Germany became part of the Soviet Union and was renamed to Kaliningrad in 1946. After the fall of the USSR, Kaliningrad became part of Russia.

spots.name: Königsberg Cathedral

hours.note: Typical hours — check the official site

spots.summary: Königsberg Cathedral is a Brick Gothic-style monument in Kaliningrad, Russia, located on Kneiphof island in the Pregolya river. It is the most significant preserved building of the former city of Königsberg, which was largely destroyed in World War II.

spots.name: Königsberg Castle

hours.note: Typical hours — check the official site

spots.summary: Königsberg Castle was the seat of the grand masters of the Teutonic Order and of the dukes and kings of Prussia in the city of Königsberg. The original fortress on the site was built by the Teutonic Knights in the 1250s, then enlarged and rebuilt into a castle over the following centuries.

spots.name: Museum of the World Ocean

hours.note: Closed Mon

spots.summary: Includes two scientific research museum ships, a Cold War era submarine B-413, a floating lighthouse and a post-war fishing trawler.

spots.name: Kaliningrad Railway station
spots.summary: Kaliningrad–Passazhirsky, also called Kaliningrad South, also referred to as Königsberger Hauptbahnhof during the German past of the city, prior to 1945, is the largest railway station on the Russian Kaliningrad Railway. It is located in the westernmost point of Russia — the city of Kaliningrad.

spots.name: RV Vityaz

hours.note: Closed Mon, Tue

spots.summary: Vityaz is a research vessel that was built in 1939 by Deutsche Schiff- und Maschinenbau AG, Bremen, Germany as Mars for Neptun Line, Bremen. She served with the Kriegsmarine during World War II and was seized by the United Kingdom in 1945. She was renamed Empire Forth for the Ministry of War Transport (MoWT).

spots.name: Kaliningrad Zoo
spots.summary: The Kaliningrad Zoo was founded in 1896 as the Königsberger Tiergarten in the German town of Königsberg, which in 1945 became part of Russia and was renamed Kaliningrad. Thus, the zoo is one of the oldest zoological gardens in Russia, and one of the largest.

spots.name: Königsberg Synagogue

hours.note: Typical hours — check the official site

spots.summary: The Königsberg Synagogue, called at the time, the New Synagogue, was a former Orthodox Jewish congregation and synagogue, located in Königsberg in Prussia, East Prussia, Germany.

spots.name: Kaliningrad Regional Amber Museum

hours.note: Closed Mon

spots.summary: The Kaliningrad Regional Amber Museum is a museum located in the Russian city of Kaliningrad devoted to housing and displaying amber artworks. It is located in the city center, on the shore of Lake Verkhneye. Construction on the museum began in 1972.

spots.name: Cathedral of Christ the Saviour

hours.note: Typical hours — check the official site

spots.summary: The Cathedral of Christ the Saviour in the Russian city of Kaliningrad is the largest church of Kaliningrad Oblast. It is the dominant building of the inner city and is situated near the central square, called Ploshchad Pobedy.

spots.name: Victory Square
spots.summary: Victory Square is the central square in Kaliningrad, Russia.

spots.name: Fort Friedrichsburg

hours.note: Closed Mon, Tue

spots.summary: Fort Friedrichsburg or Feste Friedrichsburg was a fort in Königsberg, Germany. The only remnant of the former fort is the Friedrichsburg Gate in Kaliningrad, Russia.

spots.name: King's Gate

hours.note: Closed Mon, Tue

spots.summary: The King's Gate is one of the former six gates that were built during the 19th century around Kaliningrad.

spots.name: Königsberg Stock Exchange

hours.note: Closed Mon

spots.summary: The Königsberg Stock Exchange is a former stock exchange in now Kaliningrad, Russia. One of the few buildings in central Königsberg to survive World War II, it is now a cultural centre.

spots.name: Brandenburg Gate
spots.summary: The Brandenburg Gate is one of seven surviving city gates in Kaliningrad, the former German city of Königsberg. The gate is located on Bagration Street and is the only gate of Kaliningrad still in use for the intended purpose.

spots.name: Kaliningrad Museum of Fine Arts

hours.note: Closed Mon; Typical hours — check the official site

spots.summary: Kaliningrad Museum of Fine Arts is an art gallery in Kaliningrad, Russia, located in Moskovsky Prospect.

spots.name: Church of the Holy Family, Kaliningrad

hours.note: Typical hours — check the official site

spots.summary: The Catholic Church of the Holy Family is a neogothic brick church in Kaliningrad. It was built in the Haberberg city district of Königsberg, near the Pregel river, between 1904 and 1907.
spots.wikipediaTitle: Church of the Holy Family, Kaliningrad

spots.name: Altstadt
spots.summary: Altstadt was a quarter of central Königsberg, Prussia. During the Middle Ages it was the most powerful of the three towns that composed the city of Königsberg, the others being Löbenicht and Kneiphof. Its territory is now part of Kaliningrad, Russia.

spots.summary: The Schlosskirche or Schloßkirche was a Protestant church within Königsberg Castle in Königsberg.

spots.name: Rossgarten Gate
spots.summary: The Rossgarten Gate is one of seven surviving city gates of Kaliningrad, Russia, formerly the German city of Königsberg. It is located at the intersection of Chernyakhovskogo street and Alexander Nevsky street, near the Vasilevskiy square and the Kaliningrad Amber Museum.

spots.summary: St. Adalbert's Church is a former Roman Catholic church in western Königsberg, Amalienau suburb, Germany, modern day Kaliningrad. It is now used by the Russian Orthodox Church.

spots.name: SRT-129

hours.note: Closed Mon; Typical hours — check the official site

spots.summary: SRT-129 is a medium-sized fishing trawler. It was built in the 1950s for the USSR in the German Democratic Republic. Since 2007, it has been one of the exhibits at the Museum of the World Ocean in Kaliningrad. It is the only museum fishing vessel in Russia.

spots.name: New Altstadt Church

hours.note: Typical hours — check the official site

spots.summary: The New Altstadt Church, also known simply as Altstadt Church, was a Protestant church in the Altstadt quarter of Königsberg, Germany. It was built as a replacement for the dismantled medieval Altstadt Church.

spots.name: Kaliningrad Central Park
spots.summary: Kaliningrad Central Park is a park in Kaliningrad, Russia. It was known as Luisenwahl while part of Königsberg, Germany, until 1945.

spots.name: Kaliningrad City Hall
spots.summary: Kaliningrad City Hall is the seat of government in Kaliningrad, Russia. It is located at Victory Square.

spots.name: Bell tower

hours.note: Typical hours — check the official site

spots.summary: The Bell tower in Königsberg was a bell tower of the Schlosskirche, Königsberg. After being largely destroyed in World War II by Allied Forces and then annexed by the Soviet Union thereafter, the city was renamed Kaliningrad, and few traces of the former Königsberg remain today.

spots.summary: The Kaliningrad Regional Drama Theatre is a theatre in Kaliningrad, Russia.
